summary: Braskem S.A. filed a 6-K furnishing a Material Fact disclosing that Brazil's 2nd Bankruptcy and Judicial Reorganization Court issued a decision in the extrajudicial reorganization proceeding covering the company and certain subsidiaries (the Debtors). The filing, dated September 25, 2026, follows prior Material Facts of August 18, 24 and 28, 2026. Braskem states it has not been formally served and the decision awaits official publication; management is assessing consequences and next steps. No terms, advisor, board recommendation or court-approved plan were disclosed. Watch for publication, creditor/Debtor positions, and any conversion to judicial reorganization.
